profile.summary: The International Rescue Committee (IRC) is a nonprofit humanitarian organization that responds to conflict and disaster around the world. It also works in the United States, including an Oakland office that helps refugees and other newcomers with resettlement, employment, legal help, health and wellness, and youth services.
